title: Surveillance Finding
description: Normalized finding emitted by any of the three surveillance jobs. One object per detected change/candidate. Datasets are arrays of these.

finding_id.description: Unique per emission (uuid or run-scoped id).

fingerprint.description: STABLE idempotency key = hash(source_id + change_type + change_signature). The GitHub sync searches open issues for this before creating one, so re-runs never open duplicates. A dismissed fingerprint is NOT reopened.

source_id.description: Foreign key into config/source_registry.yaml (e.g. 'fda-drug-safety'). For link-monitor findings on arbitrary outbound links, use 'link:<domain>'.

modality.description: signal_only findings must NOT include copyrighted content in evidence.diff_excerpt.

severity.description: P0 issue immediately + notify; P1 issue; P2 batched digest. See REVIEW_RULES.md.

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner. This becomes the GitHub issue title (prefixed with severity + source_id for idempotent search).

evidence.description: Provenance for audit/accreditation. Omit copyrighted text for signal_only sources.

diff_excerpt.description: Normalized text diff. EMPTY for signal_only sources.

snapshot_url.description: Apify key-value store URL of the captured snapshot (page or PDF).

affects.description: Repo-relative curriculum paths that cite this source, resolved via config/citation_index.json. Drives routing and the reviewed.json re-attestation prompt.

recommended_action.description: e.g. 'Re-verify APA MDD dosing table on t_mood.md; re-stamp reviewed.json when confirmed.'

github_issue.description: Issue URL once opened (null for P2/digest-only).

examples.summary: [P0][fda-drug-safety] New boxed-warning communication added since last scan
examples.recommended_action: Confirm whether an affected teaching med is involved; open issue; re-stamp reviewed.json on resolution.
